title: Bimedial

inlines.v: BIME'DIAL, adjective [Latin bis, twice, and medial.] In mathematics, if two medial lines, A B and B C, commensurable only in power, and containing a rational rectangle, are compounded, the whole line A C will be irrational, and is called a first bimedial line. 1. Belonging to a quantity arising from a particular combination of two other quantities.
